newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Pilipinas Shell issues 500 mln-peso debt.
newsitem.headline: Pilipinas Shell issues 500 mln-peso debt.

text.p: Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp, a unit of the Royal/Dutch Shell Group of Companies, said on Wednesday it had started issuing 500 million pesos worth of long-term commercial papers.

This represents the first tranche of the two billion-peso worth of long-term papers registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission and which had been given a triple A grade by the Credit Investigation Bureau Inc, the company said in a statement.
The underwritng agreement for the first tranche was signed last Monday with a syndicate of underwriters led by BPI Capital Corp.

"The peso flotation is aimed at diversifying Shell's funding sources and instruments as it enters the full deregulation of the oil industry," said Pilipinas Shell chairman and president Reinier Willems.

Shell will be investing 2.5 billion pesos yearly over the next five years to upgrade its refinery facilities, improve and expand distribution, storage and service station network throughout the country, the statement said.
